scope_note: Generated locally from the archived authors' v1.0.0 code; these are not recovered members of the paper's original 10,000-scenario dataset and have not been assigned paper training/validation/test splits.

author_source_provenance.scope: Authors' public v1.0.0 release; not a claim of recovered final paper splits.

sampling.lane: author random choice from the selected direction's valid lanes
sampling.destination: author random choice from destinations allowed for the selected lane
sampling.balancing: author rejection sampling until equal conflict/no-conflict counts per group
sampling.precision: author floating-point values retained; no decimal rounding
sampling.distribution_note: Balanced acceptance changes the final joint distribution from raw random proposals.

duplicate_policy: Reject duplicate physical states across existing/new scenarios, ignoring IDs and vehicle order.
